title: •Luke? Luuuuke!
caption: •Luke? Luuuuke! (V)
game_text: Deploy on your non-droid character present at a battleground site; character may not leave here or move. Target a Jedi at a site. You lose no more than 1 Force to Force drains at target’s location. This Utinni Effect canceled when reached by target.
lore: “All right, I’ll be right there, Aunt Beru.”
copyright: TM & © 1995 LUCASFILM LTD. TM, ® & © 1995 DECIPHER INC.
notes: Unique. Banner UTINNI EFFECT (printed base is also a Utinni Effect). Curly apostrophe in target’s; no inline icons; slip text matches the stub. The sheet cover notes 'Errata to card #8 and #27 on June 25, 2007': this crop is the post-errata text (taken as final). The slip's bottom strip prints an extra small bronze sphere in a silver ring between the caption and the number '27' — the same mark sits on #08, the other erratum card, so it is the sheet's errata marker; recorded as 'errata_mark': true, not part of caption/number. (GEMP's later VB text reads 'may not be carried from here' — a later revision, not this slip.) Lore corrected from the scan: 'All right, I’ll' with a comma (wiki has a period), curly double quotes (wiki straight single), confirmed on the VB1 scan. Only a 350 px scan; copyright 1995 (Premiere) by set. Modern: Virtual Block 1 only (VB1 -pre, 350 px).
